name: RangeSlider
summary: Single-handle or dual-handle bar slider. Sunken track + lime active range + white-with-hairline-border handles. Built on native <input type='range'>.

value.description: Single number for single-handle; [low, high] tuple for dual-handle.

format.description: Function (n: number) => string for the value label beneath the track.

ariaLabel.description: Single-handle label, OR low-handle label in dual mode.

keyboard: Home — set to min; End — set to max
Tab — move to the second handle in dual mode
rules: Each handle is native <input type='range'> so AT announces role + value + min/max.
Single-handle: aria-label describes the value's meaning ('Volume').
Dual-handle: each handle gets its own label ('Minimum price', 'Maximum price').
Honor the lime focus ring on the thumb — never `outline: none` without a replacement.
Clamp dual-handle so low <= high on every change.

do: Use dual-handle only when bracketing a range; single-handle covers most cases.
Render value labels beneath the track, not floating on the handle.
Format labels with the relevant unit ($32, 14 lb, 88%).
Set sensible step (5 for percentage, 10 for currency).
dont: Don't ship a slider without min / max.
Don't use a slider for high-precision values — typing is faster.
Don't allow dual-handle handles to cross — clamp low <= high on every change.

changelog.note: Initial release. Promotes the v0.6 audit-dashboard primitive in inputs.tsx to a dedicated contract. Single + dual-handle modes; native <input type='range'> overlay with custom thumb / track via webkit-thumb pseudo-element.
